parsed.note_claim: Popcorn lung is not linked to vaping and diacetyl is banned in regulated e-liquids.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: No, vaping does not cause "popcorn lung", the common name for a rare disease called bronchiolitis obliterans. ... Diacetyl is contained in cigarette smoke, but it is banned as an ingredient in UK-regulated nicotine vapes and e-liquids.
parsed.reason: The NHS page directly states that vaping does not cause popcorn lung and that diacetyl is banned in UK-regulated e-liquids, substantiating the note's claims.
